_note: Ground truth for the fish-audio-hermes benchmark. No numerals and no number words, so WER/CER needs no number normalization. Edit = new corpus version; bump corpus_version.

asr_corpus.text: Good morning.
Please remind me to call the dentist tomorrow afternoon.
The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog near the riverbank.
Can you summarize the meeting notes and send them to the whole team before lunch?
Turn off the kitchen lights.
I would like a quiet table near the window for my family on Friday evening.
What is the weather going to be like in London this weekend?
Our quarterly report shows steady growth across every region, although shipping costs rose sharply during the summer months and we expect them to stay high.
Schedule a reminder.
She sells seashells by the seashore, and the shells she sells are surely seashells.
おはようございます。
明日の午後に会議の資料を送ってください。
今日は天気がいいので、公園まで散歩に行きませんか。
新しいプロジェクトの進捗について、来週の月曜日までに報告書をまとめる予定です。
東京駅で待ち合わせをしましょう。
你好，很高兴认识你。
请帮我把明天的会议提醒设置好。
今天天气很好，我们一起去公园散步吧。
这个项目的进展很顺利，我们计划在下周之前完成所有的测试工作。
请把厨房的灯关掉。

tts_lengths.short: Hello, this is a short voice check from the Fish Audio plugin.
tts_lengths.medium: Thanks for waiting. I checked your calendar and moved the design review to Thursday afternoon, because the conference room was already booked on Wednesday. I also sent a short note to the team explaining the change. If anyone cannot make the new time, they can reply to the thread and I will find another slot.

ja: 明日の朝、駅の前で会いましょう。
zh: 明天早上我们在车站门口见面吧。
